name: calendly
description: Manage Calendly scheduling via the official Calendly-hosted MCP server. List and manage event types, view upcoming meetings, check availability, schedule with invitees, and administer your organisation. Browser OAuth 2.1 + PKCE — no API keys required.

connection.instructions: Click **Connect** to sign in to Calendly. You will be redirected to Calendly's authorisation page — sign in and grant access. The MCP server uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and Dynamic Client Registration (RFC 7591): no client ID or secret is needed on your side.
